description: The aifree.dev/stack builder: for a template (chat, rag, image, voice, agent, finetune) one free pick per slot (llm, emb, vec, host, gpu, tts, stt, image) with alternatives, the tightest published LLM requests per day, cards and programs to watch, and a shareable URL. Optionally pin a slot to an offer slug, require no card, or limit to a country.

noCard.description: true = only offers that never ask for a card

picks.description: Pin slots to offer slugs, e.g. { "llm": "groq-free-tier" }

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "VN"; unknown codes are ignored

name: build_stack
title: Build a free AI stack
